title: Unique normalization of the common-stage unit comparison at the coefficient unit
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X with l invertible in every residue field, a locally finite adic realization R, a native closed structure closed, its tensor models models, symmetry, and data of CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit [new-sf-adic-completed-tensor-common-lift-tensor-unit, def-sf-native-adic-realization-data]. Put U = pullbackTensorCommonUnit and V = ordinary(U). For the fixed tensorator data.tensor, there exists exactly one isomorphism unit from the native tensor unit to V such that tensor(id_V,unit.hom), followed by data.tensor at (U,U), followed by ordinary of the common right unitor at U, equals the native right unitor at V. This is a law at U only; it does not assert any law at other objects or identify an arbitrary data.unit with this unique comparison.

proof.text: Let q be the tensorator at (U,U) followed by ordinary of the common right unitor. Transport fullness and faithfulness of the identity along the natural left unitor to tensoring on the left by the native unit. Then transport them along tensoring data.unit with identity maps to the functor V tensor -.

Lift the isomorphism rho_V followed by q inverse along the fully faithful functor V tensor -. Its preimage is an isomorphism from the native unit to V. The map-preimage identity and cancellation q inverse followed by q give the required equation.
If b is another unit comparison satisfying that equation, compare its composite with q with the constructed one. Apply tensorUnitComparison_unique and Iso.ext to obtain equality of the isomorphisms.

from.place: Normalize the comparison at the common coefficient unit before claiming a right-unit equation

lean.statement:
theorem completed_tensor_common_lift_unit_normalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (R : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l X)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    (closed : CoefficientClosedStructure (ambientHom l X R))
    (models : CoefficientTensorModels.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed)
    (symmetry : @SymmetricCategory _ _ closed.monoidal)
    (data : CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry) :
    ∃! unit : closed.monoidal.tensorUnit ≅
        (ordinary l X R).obj (pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) X),
      closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) unit.hom) ≫
          data.tensor.hom.app
            (pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) X,
             pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) X) ≫
          (ordinary l X R).map (pullbackTensorCommonRightUnitor l (PadicAlgCl l) X
            (pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) X)).hom =
        (closed.monoidal.rightUnitor ((ordinary l X R).obj
          (pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) X))).hom
